hero.sub: Turn your ideas and repetitive tasks into AI-powered workflows that work for you. Build agents, automate processes, and monitor everything from one intelligent platform.

coreValue.headline: Don't just use AI. Put it to work.
coreValue.body: Asking AI a question is one thing. Using Flow to execute an entire process — automatically, reliably, at scale — is something else entirely.
coreValue.exampleRequest: Analyze this week's sales, create a report, send it to my team, and alert me if revenue drops.

features.headline: Everything your AI workforce needs.
features.sub: Six purpose-built capabilities that work together as one.

agents.title: AI Agents
agents.body: Create specialized AI workers with goals, instructions, tools, memory, and permissions. Your AI team never sleeps.

workflows.title: Workflow Builder
workflows.body: Connect agents, tools, conditions, and triggers. Sequential pipelines, parallel execution, approval gates, and automatic retries.

agentos.title: AgentOS
agentos.body: The command center for your AI workforce. Monitor runs, jobs, and results. Catch errors before they become problems.

gateway.title: AI Gateway
gateway.body: A unified intelligent routing layer. Send every request to the right model for the right task — maximize quality, minimize cost.

memory.title: Memory
memory.body: Give your agents context that persists across workflows. Agents remember what matters, improve over time, and work smarter on every run.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.body: Connect your existing tools and data sources. Flow plugs into your stack — no rebuild required.

howItWorks.headline: From idea to automation in five steps.

steps.title: Tell Flow What You Want
steps.body: Describe the outcome in natural language. No technical knowledge required.

steps.title: Build Your Workflow
steps.body: Connect agents, tools, conditions, and approvals. Flow turns your description into an executable workflow.

steps.title: Run
steps.body: Execute manually on demand, or trigger automatically on a schedule or event.

steps.title: Monitor
steps.body: Track every job, run, and agent result in real time. Full visibility, zero surprises.

steps.title: Improve
steps.body: Analyze results, refine your workflow, and deploy improvements. Your AI workforce gets smarter over time.

benefits.headline: Work happens. Even when you're not.

items.title: Save Time
items.body: Automate repetitive work. Reclaim hours every week.

items.title: Work Smarter
items.body: Let AI execute tasks while people focus on decisions that matter.

items.title: Scale
items.body: Turn manual processes into repeatable, reliable systems.

items.title: Stay in Control
items.body: Monitor, approve, and override. Full visibility at every step.

trust.headline: Built for teams that care about security.

items.title: Multi-tenant
items.body: Full organization and team isolation out of the box.

items.title: Role permissions
items.body: Fine-grained access control for every resource.

items.title: Observability
items.body: Full audit trail and real-time monitoring.

pro.name: Pro
pro.description: For teams moving fast with AI.
